main.description: A governance question a guild votes on — the anchor that `vote` attestations point at. Written to the proposer's repo. threshold/quorum are INTEGER PERCENTS (0-100); omit to inherit the charter's per-action defaults. A proposal may ENACT a collective authority decision: set `action` + `enacts` and, on passing, it mutates membership/mandates (the founder-free authority model — see notes/designation-primitive.md §8).

guild.description: The guild this proposal belongs to (AT-URI / id).

action.description: Optional: the authority act this proposal enacts on passing. Picks the charter `rules.vote[action]` bar.

enacts.description: Payload for `action`, e.g. admit/remove {grantee}; grant_mandate {grantee, capability, scope, mode}; recall {target | grantee, capability, scope}; amend {rules} (inline new charter rules) or {charter} (strongRef to a new org.buildguild.charter chained by prev) — on passing under the PRIOR charter's amend bar, it swaps the active rules for subsequent proposals (self-amending; the genesis cohort is preserved). May also carry causal edges that order this act WITHOUT a clock: `target` (the grant a recall cancels) and `supersedes` (the act a re-grant replaces) — both strongRef cids.

basis.description: Causal parent: the membership HEAD this proposal builds on (the cid of the last roster-changing act it assumes; the charter at genesis). Sequencing is the topological order of these `basis`/`target`/`supersedes` edges, tie-broken by ref hash — never by a wall clock. See notes/designation-primitive.md §8.
